function: VAE reconstructs user distances for sensing; transformer allocates power for holographic beamforming by activating HGA grids, maximising a sensing utility function (beampattern gain, energy efficiency, cross-correlation); pp. 7-10.
system: Cell-free ISAC, 6 holographic MIMO BSs with 4-grid reconfigurable holographic surface each, 2 to 20 users, no reflecting RIS, 28 GHz; Table I, p. 11.
method: VAE for distance reconstruction (unsupervised, KL plus reconstruction loss) and transformer with multi-head attention for power (supervised, MSE against ground truth); Adam, 200 and 100 epochs; pp. 8-11.
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset [62], [63] at 28 GHz, preprocessed with the DeepMIMO generator, scenario not named; users 125 to 325 m from BSs; ground-truth power from DeepMIMO; pp. 10, 13.
test_conditions: Training and validation curves on one DeepMIMO-derived dataset (five users, six BSs); number of users varied 2 to 20 with more grids, retraining not stated; pp. 10-12, 16.
baselines: Learned: LSTM and GRU for both sensing (distance reconstruction) and power allocation; no non-learned baseline; DeepMIMO ground-truth power as reference only; pp. 11-15.
metrics: MSE loss, MAE of reconstructed distances, cross-correlation, allocated power versus ground truth, cumulative power savings, SINR, energy efficiency, sensing utility function; pp. 12-16.
complexity: Big-O stated: VAE O(SU r^2 (1 + alpha beta^2 e)) (p. 9); transformer O(T^2 fd + T fd^2) (p. 10); LSTM/GRU O(k kd^2 + k kd kh) (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 10: "We preprocess data from the DeepMIMO data set to prepare our data set for performance evaluation". The ground-truth power also comes from DeepMIMO (p. 13); the DeepMIMO scenario is not named.
q2_support: p. 16: "we varied the total number of users in the proposed system from 2 to 20" "while simultaneously increasing the number of grids in the HMIMO BSs". The paper does not say that a model trained for one setting is tested on another, or whether it is retrained per setting; no unseen scenario, band or site is reported.
q3_support: p. 11: "LSTM and GRU are considered as the baseline methods". Both are learned; no non-learned baseline is compared, and the DeepMIMO ground truth (p. 13) is the reference label, not a competing method.
q4_support: p. 9: "the overall computational complexity of Algorithm 1 is O(SU × r2 × (1 + α × β 2 × e))" for the VAE; p. 10 gives O(T 2 × fd + T × fd 2 ) for the transformer.
q5_support: p. 10: "We preprocess data from the DeepMIMO data set to prepare our data set for performance evaluation"; DeepMIMO is a public dataset [62]. The paper releases no code or data link of its own.
notes: Area 5: the learned pipeline (VAE sensing of user distance, transformer power allocation for beamforming) serves sensing and communication in a holographic MIMO cell-free ISAC network (SINR and energy-efficiency terms, pp. 5-7). Half of the pipeline is user localization, so the reviewer should confirm it is not excluded by function. ris is 0 because the reconfigurable holographic surface is the BS antenna array (p. 2: HMIMO BSs replace the BSs), not a reflecting RIS in the channel; reviewer to confirm. q2 is 0 because p. 16 varies the number of users and grids without stating that an already trained model is tested on unseen settings. q3 is 0 because LSTM and GRU are the only baselines (p. 11) and none is non-learned.
